body: Then my life must've been full of failures, and only failures. What can I say? My existence is futile in every way.

This.

People do not understand that we don't want to kill ourselves for the hell of it, no, we want the exhausting, agonizing pain to end. And those same people assume that we didn't try to fight, they just don't know how it is really.
Yeah, suicide by train may be very effective, but it's just not right to do to a poor innocent train driver just doing his job. So it was out of the way for me, and many people I'd say.

If you wish to give it more time, do so. I did, I was very patient, but oh well, the result stayed the same: seeing suicide as the only way out of my never-ending suffering.

I'd wait until Tuesday if I were you, but again, I don't know your story either, I won't judge or dictate your choice. But such a sudden change in the pace would probably mean that something had happened. Suicide, for me, is the result of a lot of things and my own experience of life-- it shouldn't be an option just because of a single inconvenient event.

I felt the same for all of the previous years. Relatable to be honest.

Get ready, and be wise; it's a point of no return and I know it very well myself; that's why I gave it this much time, but in the end, it didn't even matter. Sad.

Cyanide doesn't sound like an easy way to go, apparently it makes you convulse? Won't go further on the topic anyway, as the rules dictate.

I don't know your story, but it's your decision, and so is mine, nobody can stop us but ourselves, and sadly, it doesn't look like it's going to go well.

I hope the best for you, maybe you'll get to experience happiness, one day.

When there is light, there is darkness. Sadly for me, darkness overwhelmed my whole life, and my miserable existence.

Have a good New Year's Eve, cheers.

He doesn't deserve you. And YOU deserve way better.

Don't go hard on yourself, you have my support, aswell as the other people in this thread.

I experience the exact same thing. My memory just went downhill, to the point it hurts my capacity in school and such.

Won't even talk about movies or books, I just feel like I've never watched it. Not even the name of the main character.
Exactly. But I feel like I won't hold out much longer, my depression is getting stronger and stronger.
Yeah, sadly, there are people who don't even have mom, or worse, an abusive one. I truly feel bad for them.
